meta.purpose: Aggregate flight callsign prefixes into embedding-friendly airline/operator buckets (reduce sparse categorical cardinality while preserving signal for route/country prediction).
meta.source_field: callsign (flight record), typically from OpenSky; prefixes are derived from the first 3 letters after normalization
normalization_tip: STRIP (OpenSky callsign often has trailing spaces)
EXTRACT PREFIX = first 3 alphabetic characters (recommended) OR first 3 chars after cleanup

fallbacks.other: if prefix not found in mapping -> OTHER

mapping_rules.ambiguity_policy: If a prefix can refer to multiple operators historically or via wet-lease, map it to the dominant operator in your dataset (or keep a neutral 'operator_group' label).

recommended_fields_per_group.label: stable machine-friendly bucket id (snake_case)
recommended_fields_per_group.codes: list of callsign prefixes belonging to this bucket (strings)

flags.operator_type: e.g., scheduled_airline | low_cost | charter | cargo | business_aviation | military | government | unknown
flags.region_focus: e.g., europe | uk_ie | nordics | dache | iberia | csee | global

notes: These are ICAO-style callsign prefixes seen in the callsign field; they are NOT IATA codes.
Callsigs may be missing, malformed, or not airline-related (private/military/GA). Keep UNKNOWN/OTHER buckets to avoid dropping rows.
If you later add aircraft-type features, consider separating 'business_aviation' from 'scheduled_airline' even more aggressively—those patterns correlate strongly with airports/regions.

groups.label: Lufthansa Group (passenger)
groups.description: Lufthansa Group passenger operators (Lufthansa mainline, Austrian, Eurowings). Strongly predictive of DACH/central-European hubs and intra-European flows.

groups.label: Air France–KLM Group
groups.description: Air France/KLM plus Transavia (NL/FR). Strong signal for CDG/ORY/AMS-centric networks and leisure routes.

groups.label: IAG (Iberia/Vueling/Aer Lingus)
groups.description: IAG-related operators in your set. Strong signal for Spain/UK/Ireland connectivity and major hubs.

groups.label: Turkish Airlines (hub carrier)
groups.description: Large hub-and-spoke operator centered on IST; frequent across Europe and highly informative for international legs.

groups.label: Nordics / North Atlantic flag carriers
groups.description: Major Nordic operators (Scandinavia, Finland) plus Icelandair; useful for Nordic airports and North Atlantic patterns.

groups.label: Southern Europe flag carriers
groups.description: Portugal/Italy/Greece mainline carriers. Good signal for LIS/OPO, FCO/MXP, ATH hubs and regional connectivity.

groups.label: Central/Eastern Europe & Benelux flag carriers
groups.description: LOT + Brussels Airlines. Useful for WAW and BRU-centric patterns and connections across Europe.

groups.label: Ryanair Group
groups.description: High-volume European LCC; extremely predictive of secondary airports and cross-border point-to-point flows.

groups.label: easyJet (all AOCs)
groups.description: easyJet group AOCs (UK/Europe/Switzerland). Strong signal for Western Europe city-pairs.

groups.label: Wizz Air
groups.description: High-volume LCC with strong CEE/SEE footprint; informative for regional airport patterns.

groups.label: Other major EU LCC / leisure-LCC
groups.description: Volotea + Pegasus + SunExpress. Useful volume without exploding the vocabulary.

groups.label: EU leisure / charter airlines
groups.description: TUI family + Condor + Smartwings + Neos. Strong seasonality and leisure-destination signal.

groups.label: DHL Aviation
groups.description: DHL Aviation-related operators; highly predictive for cargo hubs and night-wave patterns.

groups.label: European cargo network carriers
groups.description: Cargolux + Lufthansa Cargo + ASL cargo operators. Strong signal for LUX/LEJ/CGN/LGG-type hubs.

groups.label: Global cargo / integrators
groups.description: UPS/FedEx plus major long-haul cargo carriers. Useful for intercontinental freight patterns.

groups.label: Middle East global hubs
groups.description: Emirates/Qatar/Etihad-style long-haul hub operators; strong signal for intercontinental legs into Europe.

groups.label: Other intercontinental majors
groups.description: Non-European majors that commonly appear in Europe (US/Asia/Africa/Israel). Helpful without overfitting to many singletons.

groups.label: Business aviation / fractional
groups.description: NetJets/Executive Jet Management/VistaJet-type patterns. Keep separate because their airport usage differs from airlines.

groups.label: Special mission / air ambulance / misc ops
groups.description: Non-scheduled/special-purpose operator(s) you may want isolated from commercial patterns.

groups.label: Other / long tail operators
groups.description: Catch-all bucket for everything not matched above (small charter, GA, tiny cargo, local operators, etc.).
